label_consumption.reason: The execution had already loaded the authorized match result labels, built labeled formal rows, evaluated the frozen sample gate, and entered run_oos before the exception.

sample_gate.reason: The code calls run_oos only in the branch reached after all frozen sample gates evaluate true. The process crashed inside run_oos. No receipt was written before the crash, so exact in-memory counts are not asserted post hoc.

root_cause: The frozen design created the first formal OOS fold without guaranteeing any eligible labeled training rows strictly before that fold start. This was not detected by the pre-label zero-label coverage gates because label eligibility and first-fold trainability were not separately preflighted.
next_research_requirement: Any future scientific effect test must use genuinely independent/unconsumed labels and add a zero-label/trainability preflight that guarantees a nonempty fixed training set before fold 1 without changing R44L7C after seeing its labels.
